text:
anya (AE): Morning folks — quick async check-in for a few deals (short bullets). What I did: demo with NovaHealth yesterday, sent updated SOW, added Qs to support ticket #452. Blockers: customer requires BYOK with HSM keywrap and explicitly says Redwood must not retain plaintext keys; legal asked for cryptography compliance notes. Need engineering + security confirmation on feasibility and perf impact before committing pilot date. Today: follow up with Nova, update pilot runbook, and gather eng answers.

ben (SRM): Noted. Tentative pilot window we've been talking about is mid-April. Reassigning chloe to lead the eng handoff. @chloe can you confirm availability and who to loop from eng?

chloe (sales-eng): I can take this. Need the exact customer spec — can you paste the KMS/BYOK snippet here? If they insist on keys never leaving customer HSM, we likely need Private or a VPC-backed Dedicated with KMS proxy. Will ping eng-runtime for perf numbers.

carl (security): Quick security note: we need the threat model and who controls the key material. If keys must remain in customer HSM (no export), that's BYOK with keywrap; technically doable but will affect onboarding and evidence we can provide (attestations, audit logs). Please confirm whether FIPS/SOC2-level attestation is required.

anya (AE): Pasting the customer's requirement from the RFP:

``
Keys must be generated and stored in Customer HSM; Redwood must not store or export key material. Mutual TLS required for all control channels. Audit logs must record keywrap operations and key usage. Target p50 tail latency for inference calls < 100ms.
``

sam (revops): Contracting/billing check — do we gate the pilot on proof of key separation? Also need to confirm billing model for Dedicated pilot (monthly commit vs hourly). Looping in @legal and @finance for contract language and pricing guidance.

chloe (sales-eng): @eng-runtime-team @eng-platform — can someone confirm whether using an external HSM keywrap (via KMS proxy) will add measurable per-request latency? If yes, any suggestions for mitigating (caching wrapped keys, async unwrap on session start, batch keywraps)? Ballpark numbers appreciated.

infra-bot: :robot_face: Heads up: Dedicated pilot runbook and KMS integration guide were updated -> https://redwood.ai/internal/dedicated-pilot-kms

ben (SRM): If eng wants a short test harness, I can spin up a test tenant and provide short-lived key material for perf runs. Say the word.

carl (security): Also recommend we add a short addendum to the SOW that describes key handling obligations (no-export clause) and an acceptance test for audit logs. I can draft language.

anya (AE): Thanks — Chloe, can you sync with runtime and security and reply in-thread by EOD? If engineering gives the green light, I'll lock the pilot date. :thumbsup:

ben (SRM): +1

chloe (sales-eng): On it, pinging eng-runtime now. @eng-runtime: could someone chime in with perf/caching tradeoffs?
